legalSummary: Controller: Instal Berrozpe S.L. We will use the details you provide to answer your enquiry and, if requested, prepare a quote. The legal basis is taking pre-contractual steps you request or our legitimate interest in answering general enquiries.

The form is hosted and processed by Vercel, Resend sends the message, and Google Workspace receives it in the company mailbox. Some providers may process data outside the EEA; the full policy explains the applicable safeguards.

We will keep your enquiry while handling it and afterwards for applicable legal periods. Resend keeps email and log data for 30 days on its Free plan. You may exercise your rights and lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD).
